style.styleTitle: Nkuku Mini Oko Bauble Christmas Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: This handmade wreath brings together mini baubles in a mix of bestselling colours, clustered tightly for a full look, along with a textured finish. Each bauble has a soft matte tone that adds a heritage-inspired, understated feel. This wreath is strung with a sari tie, introducing subtle colour and a unique, hand-finished detail. Ideal for hanging on doors or walls, or styled as part of a festive centrepiece, it's a versatile piece that adds warmth and character to festive styling. Each Sari tie is one of a kind, so the piece you receive will vary slightly from the images shown, due to its individual character and handmade nature. Dimensions(mm):  Height: 200 Width: 100  Depth: 200.
